subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Which Microsoft Teams Graph media fallback policy should resolve this issue: always attempt the plugin-owned Graph lookup for non-personal HTML stubs, require an explicit default-off `graphMediaFallback` setting, or another consolidated policy?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the durable behavior changes Graph call volume, diagnostics, and operator configuration semantics, and two open PRs now propose different product tradeoffs.

options.title: Consolidate the linked fixes
options.body: Choose the fallback policy once, reconcile the channel URL fixes from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 with the group-chat/default-off evidence from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096, and land one coherent fix path.

options.title: Land the always-on plugin fallback
options.body: Accept the extra Graph lookup behavior as the correct default so configured Teams users get inbound channel attachments without another setting.

options.title: Land the default-off config flag
options.body: Preserve current behavior by default and require operators to opt in to the extra Graph lookup cost and permission dependency.

recommendation.title: Consolidate the linked fixes
recommendation.body: Choose the fallback policy once, reconcile the channel URL fixes from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 with the group-chat/default-off evidence from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096, and land one coherent fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a plugin-boundary/config-policy decision, and this history shows relevant Microsoft Teams plugin and repo policy ownership context.
